I am a cognitive scientist and data scientist interested in how the mind learns and processes language. My scientific work has two goals: to understand the computational machinery that enables children and adults to learn and process language, and to use advanced statistical modelling and reproducible data-science methods to uncover patterns in linguistic behaviour.

## Research areas

- Cognitive basis of language learning and processing
- Quantitative data analysis
- Psycholinguistic experiments
- Corpus analysis
- Computational modelling
- Reproducible research
